newsitem.title: SPAIN: Aninat sees less austere Chile money policy by H2.
newsitem.headline: Aninat sees less austere Chile money policy by H2.

text.p: Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat said he expects Chilean monetary policy to be less austere by mid-year.

In an interview with Reuters Financial Television to be broadcast on Monday, Aninat said "By the second semester of this year...Chile will have left, one way or another, a very harsh, very strict and austere and very strong monetary policy for a more transitional path."
The Chile central bank last reduced its key rate on February 7, lowering it to 7.25 percent from 7.50.
Aninat was speaking in Barcelona, one day before the inauguration of the 38th annual governors' meeting of the Inter-American Development Bank.
